question: Which country hosted the 1982 edition of the Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Asian Games:

__
 
• It is also known as 'Asiad'.
 
• It is a continental multi-sports event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The first Asian game was held in 1951 in New Delhi, India.
 
• The motto of the Asian Games, "Ever onward" was given by Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of India.

Explanation:__

__
 
• India has hosted the Asian Games two times until now.
 
• The first edition of the Asian Games was hosted by India in 1951 and the second time in 1982.
